environment.coverage: Actual isolated PostgreSQL, HTTP and WebSocket requests; no API or database mocks

checks.name: Runtime defaults and strict production configuration accept explicit native origins
Runtime rejects weak secrets, unsafe origins, invalid ports and unbounded proxy trust without echoing secrets
Upload startup creates a private writable directory and rejects file or symlink targets
Database URL takes precedence and connects to the real PostgreSQL database
Database configuration rejects malformed ports and TLS downgrade settings without exposing URL credentials
Preparing an empty database installs the schema and migrations exactly once and preserves persistent data
A partially populated database is rejected without overwriting objects or creating application tables
Recorded migration checksum changes fail closed and leave application data unchanged
Administrator bootstrap requires explicit strong credentials and rejects invalid inputs without echoing passwords
Administrator bootstrap creates a usable account; duplicates preserve the existing account and cannot promote a customer
Gmail administrator aliases use the public login normalization and cannot create or overwrite a duplicate canonical account
Production rejects incomplete configuration before it listens and does not print provided secrets
Configured production serves liveness and real schema readiness without leaking database details
Production HTTP preflight admits only configured Android, iOS and web origins with credentials
Production applies native origin restrictions to actual WebSocket upgrades and still requires a valid session
Readiness detects a missing application table, leaves liveness up and recovers when the schema is restored
Database connection loss produces readiness 503 while liveness stays 200 and both servers recover without restart

checks.name: Database role changes remove permissions from stale admin token
REST unauthenticated reads and mutations require authentication
Other customer cannot read, cancel or alter owner order
Pending, rejected and suspended drivers cannot bypass approval
Approved driver cannot accept a mismatched vehicle order
Driver cannot accept using another driver vehicle ID
Approved alternative acceptance assigns driver and sets busy
Only assigned driver can read, start or cancel assigned order
Correct QR cannot be used by unrelated customer or driver
Finance, audit and corporate roles cannot mutate another order
Busy driver cannot take another order or set available while active
Socket no token and invalid token connections are rejected
Owner and assigned driver can track; other accounts cannot
Cross-user chat and cross-driver location cannot reach order room
Assigned driver broadcasts location and owner can chat
Vehicle feeds reject wrong type, customers and pending drivers
Malformed socket inputs cannot crash server or mutate location
Concurrent refresh has one winner, rotates token and disconnects idle socket
Password change revokes other sessions and disconnects their idle sockets
Generic cancel follows cancellation fields, fee and driver release
Same driver simultaneous accepts assign at most one order
Two drivers simultaneously accepting one order produce one winner
Logout disconnects an idle subscribed socket and revokes its token
Acceptance revokes vehicle feed; suspension disconnects idle tracking socket
Driver rejection disconnects idle subscribed socket and denies further mutation

checks.name: Pending, accepted and cancelled orders cannot be confirmed or regenerate QR
Only assigned driver generates QR; only owning customer confirms it
Ordinary order reads, lists and pending feeds never expose QR secrets
Unexpired QR generation retry returns same token and timestamps
Malformed and wrong QR codes fail without changing delivery or accounting
Receipt and cash confirmation require explicit boolean true
Missing, future and expired generation times cannot confirm delivery
Direct delivered status cannot bypass customer QR confirmation
Customer confirms cash delivery once; sequential replay changes nothing
Eight simultaneous confirmations commit exactly one delivery and payment
QR generation racing confirmation cannot rotate or double-confirm delivery
Confirmation racing cash cancellation has one winner and no double accounting or refund
QR expiry is checked after the delivery row lock wait
Concurrent confirmation and replay emit each delivered event exactly once
Noncash paid flag without matching confirmed ledger cannot deliver
Forced ledger failure rolls back all delivery and accounting changes
Forced customer_stats failure rolls back all delivery and accounting changes
Schema prevents duplicate completed payment and refund ledger events
Migration001 is idempotent and blocks historical duplicate ledger without deleting it

checks.name: Pricing conserves every cent across all configured vehicles and pricing combinations
Unimplemented card and bank payments cannot create falsely paid orders
Zero or missing wallet funds cannot create an order
Wallet currency mismatch preserves balance, orders and ledger
Wallet creation debits exactly once and records matching completed payment
Two concurrent wallet orders cannot overdraw one-order balance
Forced wallet ledger failure rolls back debit and new order atomically
Wallet cancellation through both APIs refunds the full payment once with zero fee
Concurrent wallet cancellation creates one refund and one wallet credit
Wallet refund racing delivery commits only the winning operation
Legacy refunded wallet orders cannot confirm delivery or change accounting
Payout dates and permissions reject invalid requests without reservations
Payout reserves only matching paid delivered orders, includes entire end date and excludes unfunded tips
Repeated and overlapping payout periods never reserve an order twice
Concurrent payout requests create one pending reservation for one order
Forced payout allocation failure rolls back payout and every allocation
Historical unallocated payout blocks new periods until accounting reconciliation
Financial overview excludes unfunded and refunded delivery revenue and counts only processed refunds
Legacy migrations001 and002 are repeatable and reject null or negative balances without altering history
Actual upgrade command upgrades legacy database twice and stops before002 on duplicate001 history

checks.name: First document upload recreates missing folder and stores private owned metadata
PDF, JPG, JPEG and PNG signatures upload successfully
Replacement keeps document ID, updates metadata, resets verification and removes unreferenced old file
Expiry status reflects current, near and later expiry dates
Private downloads allow owner and admin, deny everyone else and expose no public uploads
Interrupted private download does not crash server or delete stored document
Unauthenticated and customer uploads cannot write files
Invalid multipart body and calendar dates leave no rows or orphan files
Extension, declared MIME, signature and size checks reject disguised or oversized files without residue
Aborted multipart upload leaves no document or partial file
Six simultaneous replacements preserve one row and only the final referenced file
Forced document upsert failure removes new file and preserves old metadata and bytes
Replacement retains old file while an archive record references it
Safe legacy files remain privately readable while traversal and missing files are unavailable
Fresh schema enforces unique driver-document type and nonnull driver
Original legacy database upgrades001–003 twice, archives complete duplicate/orphan history and deletes no files
